CITY OF PASADENA
  City Council Minutes
  October 26, 2020, 2020 - 1:00 P.M.
  City Hall Council Chamber

  SPECIAL MEETING
  The virtual meeting was convened pursuant to Executive Order N-29-20 issued by
  Governor Gavin Newsom on March 17, 2020, and was held solely by
  videoconference/teleconference

OPENING:  Mayor Tomek called the special meeting to order at 1:03 p.m.
  (Absent: None)

  On the order of the Mayor, the special meeting recessed at 1 :04
  p.m., to discuss the following closed session:

Councilmember Madison  CITY COUNCIL CONFERENCE WITH PASADENA POLICE
joined the meeting at 1:34  CHIEF REGARDING THREATS TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR
p.m.  FACILITIES pursuant to Government Code Section 54957

  The above closed session item was discussed, with no reportable
  action at this time.

ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the special meeting of the City Council
  aued at 2:08 p.m.

  Victor M. Gordo, Ma  r
  City of Pasadena
